name: Zetsubou!! Netorare Sentai -Ore-tachi no Kizuna wa Nan Dattan Da-
original_name: 絶望!!寝取られ戦隊 -俺たちの絆はなんだったんだ-
source:
The Earth is in crisis, under attack by aliens with advanced scientific capabilities.

The monsters torment humanity with despicable means.

A man from the alien side brings technology to Earth.
With his presence, humanity has a means to fight back!

Rise up, five heroes of justice!
Don your suits of justice!
Their name is Keyranger K!!

Save the Earth with giant robots!
Now the Earth has hope!


But that was also the beginning of despair...


Keyranger K's leader, Seigi (Red), is attracted to his fellow team members, Reika (Yellow) and Hanako (Pink). And Reika and Hanako also harbor feelings for Seigi... Their delicate relationship should have blossomed someday... but the invisible bond crumbles away unseen. 

Before Seigi's final choice, it was already over. His comrades and the enemy monsters take Reika and Hanako away. When Seigi learns the truth... what kind of despairing future will this create for humanity? 

[Edited from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0118760/]Digiket[/url]]
translation:
地球陷入危机，遭到拥有先进科技的外星人袭击。

怪物们以卑劣手段折磨人类。

一位来自外星阵营的男人，将技术带到了地球。
因为他的到来，人类终于有了反击的手段！

站起来吧，五位正义的英雄！
穿上正义的战衣！
他们的名字是Keyranger K！！

驾驶巨型机器人，拯救地球！
地球终于看见了希望！

然而，那也是绝望的开端……

Keyranger K的队长正义（红），喜欢着队友丽华（黄）与花子（粉）。丽华与花子也对正义抱有感情……这份微妙的关系，本该在某天开花结果，然而，看不见的羁绊却在不为人知之处瓦解。

在正义做出最终选择之前，一切就已经结束。他的伙伴与敌方怪物夺走了丽华和花子。得知真相时……这又会为人类带来怎样绝望的未来？
